territories.name: Botswana
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Botswana levies a value added tax of its own under the Value Added Tax Act, 2026 (Act No. 15 of 2026), in force on 1 July 2026 and administered by the Botswana Unified Revenue Service: section 7 imposes it on the taxable supply, the taxable import and the reverse charged supply at 14 per cent, with a zero rate for the supplies of Schedule 1 and exemption for those of Schedule 2. Botswana is a member of the Southern African Customs Union.
